instruction: I want to reorganize my slides by dragging them around. Please switch to Slide Sorter view so I can see all slides at once and rearrange them.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(2)

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to switch to Slide Sorter view in LibreOffice Impress. Evaluator checks accessibility tree for Slide Sorter view indicators.

llm_judge_reasons: Primary check correctly looks for 'Slide Sorter' or 'Sorter' text in accessibility tree elements, which semantically verifies the view mode switch
Evaluator fully covers the instruction requirement: switching to Slide Sorter view

Fallback heuristic (counting document-frame elements with 'Slide' in name, threshold > 3) is weak and could produce false positives - normal editing view may also show multiple slides in the left panel
Primary check may have localization issues if LibreOffice uses different text in non-English versions, though this is a reasonable assumption
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Improve fallback heuristic to be more specific: instead of just counting slides, check for grid layout indicators or specific Slide Sorter view UI elements
Consider adding checks for view-specific accessibility tree structure rather than just element counts
Add verification that the view switcher UI shows 'Slide Sorter' as active/selected, if available in accessibility tree
